classification: Pre-existing verifier parsing defect exposed during the required final merged tooling run.

originalBroadRun.failure: CompilerAndAssetTests.test_actual_sdk_graph_includes_explicit_compiler_inputs_and_scoped_assets: JSONDecodeError reading the combined MSBuild log.

diagnosis: dotnet msbuild returns exit 0 but prepends an MSBuild-server-unavailable/fallback diagnostic to the combined log before its JSON output. Parsing the log as JSON fails. Reproduced without inherited observation/server-control flags.
fix: Use the SDK-supported -getResultOutputFile for graph property/item JSON and parse only that fresh structured file. Complete diagnostic logs, existing command exit checks, source-input hashing, graph scope and audit gates remain intact. No generic prefix stripping or MSBuild-server state changes.

newRegressions: Diagnostic-prefixed console output cannot contaminate the dedicated SDK result; complete diagnostic log is retained.
Missing or malformed SDK result refuses even when the console log contains valid JSON.
focusedVerification.reproduceCommand: run-with-temp python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/tooling -p deferred_dependency_cohort_test.py -k CompilerAndAssetTests -v

scope: Only the cohort verification runner, its CompilerAndAssetTests class and this U3 evidence changed. No consumer/product/C# runtime changes, owner CI changes, global server shutdown, parent snapshot/job changes, commits or pushes. No broader tests run; parent owns final synchronization and exact acceptance evidence.
